ExternalLinkageModeInfo:
Connect to an external server via WebSocket (ws://localhost:8000/ws). Supports sending and receiving both text and images.
When camera capture is enabled, images are included in WebSocket messages. The external server can also include images in its responses.
ExternalLinkageImageNote: * image is a Base64-encoded image (data URI format). When streaming, include the image only in the first chunk.
OneCommeInfo:
Retrieves comments using OneComme. OneComme must be running.
You can aggregate comments from multiple streaming platforms (YouTube, Twitch, etc.) via OneComme.
Comments starting with '#' are ignored.
OneCommeConnectionError: Failed to connect to OneComme. Please check if OneComme is running.
ConversationContinuityModeInfo: This mode allows the AI to continue the conversation on its own when there are no comments. It is only effective when a multimodal-compatible model is selected.
ConversationContinuityModeInfo2: Since LLM is called multiple times for a single response, API usage fees may increase. Please be aware of this.
ConversationContinuityModeInfo3: Depending on the selected model, it may not operate stably.
ConversationContinuityModeDisabledInfo: Conversation continuity mode cannot be used because {{reason}} is enabled.
ConversationContinuityNewTopicThresholdI: When there are no comments for this many rounds, the AI will generate a new topic.
ConversationContinuitySleepThresholdInfo: When there are no comments for this many rounds, the AI will enter sleep mode.
ConversationContinuityAdvancedPromptsInf: You can customize the prompts used in conversation continuity mode. Use the 'Reset to Default' button to restore the initial values.
ConversationContinuityPromptEvaluateInfo: A prompt that determines whether the streamer should continue speaking based on the conversation context. This text is sent as a system prompt, followed by recent conversation history as user/assistant messages. The AI returns the evaluation result in JSON format.
ConversationContinuityPromptContinuation: Guidelines for naturally continuing the conversation when there are no comments. Combined with character settings as additional system prompt instructions, sent to the AI along with recent conversation history.
ConversationContinuityPromptSelectCommen: An instruction prompt for selecting the most appropriate comment for the conversation flow. This text plus conversation history becomes the system prompt, and the comment list is sent as a user message to the AI.
ConversationContinuityPromptNewTopicInfo: An instruction prompt for generating a new related topic from the conversation. This text is sent as a system prompt, followed by recent conversation history as user/assistant messages. The AI returns topic keywords.
ConversationContinuityPromptSleepInfo: Guidelines for generating sleep dialogue when there are no comments from viewers. Combined with character settings as additional system prompt instructions, sent to the AI along with recent conversation history.
MaxPastMessages: Number of Past Messages to Keep
ModelCapabilityLegend: Model name emojis: 📷 image input / 🔍 search support (Google Gemini only) / 💡 reasoning support
APIKeyInstruction: API keys can be obtained from the links below. Enter the obtained API key in the form.
LocalLLMInfo: You need to have a local LLM server running.
LocalLLMInfo2: Please enter the URL of your local LLM (including port number) and the model name.
GroqInfo: Groq API is accessed directly from the browser.
DifyInfo: Dify only supports chatbot or agent types. If you do not receive a satisfactory answer, please delete the conversation history and ask again.
DifyInfo2: The length of conversation history depends on the Dify chatbot settings.
DifyInstruction: If you are using Dify, this system prompt is not used. Please set it in the Dify chatbot.
CharacterModelInfo: Some models may take time to load during initial display.
CharacterPositionInfo: You can fix the character's position and orientation. For VRM, the camera position is saved; for Live2D, the model position is saved.
CopyEnvVarsInfo: Copy the current character position to the clipboard in environment variable format. You can paste it into your .env file.
BackgroundSettingsDescription: You can upload and select background images for the application.
ThinkingPoseDescription: When ON, a specified pose will be displayed while waiting for the AI response after sending a message.
CharacterSettingsInfo:
This value is set as the system prompt.
Referring to the initial prompt, you can control the character's expressions and motions by specifying emotion tags. Example: [neutral]Good morning![happy]Thank you for your hard work today!
CharacterpresetInfo:
Selecting a preset changes the character prompt.
You can also switch using Cmd + Shift + 1–5 (Mac) / Ctrl + Shift + 1–5 (Windows) on the keyboard. On smartphones/tablets, this is only available when connected to an external keyboard.
VoiceEngineInstruction: Please select the voice synthesis engine to use.
KoeiromapInfo: Using Koeiromap API from Koemotion. Supports Japanese only. See below for details.
VoiceVoxInfo: Using VOICEVOX. Supports Japanese only. Since it uses a local API, you need to download and run the appropriate app for your environment from the site below.
AivisSpeechInfo: Using AivisSpeech. Supports Japanese only. Since it uses a local API, you need to download and run the appropriate app for your environment from the site below.
StyleBertVITS2Info: Using Style-Bert-VITS2. Supports Japanese, English, and Chinese only. If using a local API, you need to download and run the appropriate app for your environment from the site below. Set up the API key if necessary.
IncludeTimestampInUserMessageInfo:
Including a timestamp in user messages allows the AI to generate responses considering the time.
Please include the following text in your system prompt:

"User input may be requested with a [timestamp], which represents the time in UTC timezone at the time of the request, so please generate a response considering that time."
GoogleTTSInfo: Using Google Cloud Text-to-Speech. Supports multiple languages.
AuthFileInstruction: An API key or authentication JSON file is required. Obtain it from below, and if it's a JSON file, place it in the root folder of the repository as 'credentials.json'.
LanguageModelURL: Please select a language model from the URL below.
ConversationHistoryInfo: Recent conversations are kept as short-term memory.
APIKeyNotEntered: API key has not been entered.
EnterYourQuestion: Enter what you want to ask
AboutThisApplicationDescription:
You can enjoy conversations with 3D characters in a web browser using microphone, text input, and voice synthesis. You can change the character (VRM), personality settings, and voice adjustments.
Settings can be changed from the menu button in the top left.
AboutThisApplicationDescription2: With AITuberKit, you can enjoy conversations with AI characters in a web browser. Please check each setting item for changing characters, personality settings, and voice adjustments.
TechnologyIntroductionDescription1: This app is created by modifying pixiv's ChatVRM. The original source code is
TechnologyIntroductionDescription5: and various LLMs, for voice synthesis,
TechnologyIntroductionDescription6: and various TTS services are used. For details, please see this
LanguageCanBeSelectedFromSettings: You can select the language from Settings.
SettingsIntroDescription: Only related settings are grouped together. Choose what you need from the categories on the left or from search.
QuickStartDescription: Frequently used settings are collected on one screen. You can move to each category for detailed options.
QuickStartBasicsDescription: Set the display name, language, and other first-time options.
QuickStartDetailedDisplaySettings: Configure appearance and background in detail
QuickStartAIConversationDescription: Set only the required items for your AI service, such as API keys, endpoints, URLs, and models.
QuickStartVoiceDescription: Set the API keys, endpoints, speakers, models, styles, and other voice settings required by the selected speech engine.
QuickStartOptionalFeaturesDescription: Streaming, images, slides, and automatic speech can be opened when you want to use them.
SourceCodeDescription1: The source code of this app is available on GitHub. You can freely modify and alter it.
SourceCodeDescription2: For commercial use, please refer to the README in the same repository.
DontShowIntroductionNextTime: Don't show this dialog next time
ContactDescription: For inquiries about this app, please contact the email address or Twitter account below.
Creator: Creator Information
DocumentationDescription: For detailed usage and tutorials of AITuberKit, please visit the URL below.
PromotionDescription: Visit the promotion site below for feature introductions and use cases of AITuberKit.
GSVITTSBatchSize: GSVI TTS Batch Size (1 ~ 100 The larger the value, the faster the inference speed, but if it's too large, it may exhaust memory)
GSVITTSSpeechRate: Speaking Speed (0.5 ~ 2.0 The larger the value, the faster)
ElevenLabsInfo: Using ElevenLabs API. Supports multiple languages. Please get an API key from the URL below.
ElevenLabsVoiceIdInfo: Please select a Voice ID from the URL below.
CartesiaInfo: Using the Cartesia API. Supports multiple languages. Please obtain the API key from the URL below.
CartesiaVoiceIdInfo: Please select the Voice ID from the URL below.
ShowCharacterName: Show character name in answer field
ShowControlPanelInfo:
Even if you hide the control panel, you can display the settings screen using the shortcut below.
On smartphones/tablets, press and hold the top left corner for about 1 second to show it.
ShowInputFormInfo: Displays the message input form at the bottom of the screen.
ColorThemeInfo: You can select the application's color theme. The selected theme will be applied immediately.
SlideModeDescription: This is a mode where AI automatically presents slides. It is only available when a multimodal-compatible model is selected.
SlideModeDisabledInfo: Slide mode cannot be used because the currently selected AI model does not support multimodal input (images).
ExternalPresentationPriorityInfo: While an external presentation is assigned, it takes priority. After it is unassigned, the selected local presentation is restored.
PdfConvertDescription: Convert the PDF into data for slide mode. Available only when a multimodal-compatible model is selected.
CustomVoiceTextPlaceholder: Enter text you want to hear
PdfConvertSubmitError: Please check that the PDF file, folder name, and API key are set
SettingsBackupInfo: Save the current browser settings as a JSON file and import them into another browser. Character, background, image, slide, chat history, and long-term memory files are not included.
SettingsIncludeSecrets: Include sensitive information such as API keys
SettingsIncludeSecretsInfo: Use this for a complete migration. API keys, authorization headers, kiosk passcodes, and other sensitive information are stored as plain text in the exported file, so keep it secure.
SettingsExportSecretsConfirm: The settings file will include sensitive information such as API keys in plain text. Keep it secure and do not publish or share it. Continue?
SettingsImportInfo: Importing overwrites the current settings and reloads the page. If the file does not contain sensitive information, the current API keys and similar values are retained.
SettingsImportEnvironmentOverride: A settings file cannot be imported because continuous environment-variable overrides are enabled. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_ALWAYS_OVERRIDE_WITH_ENV_VARIABLES to false.
SettingsImportConfirmWithSecrets: Import {{filename}} and overwrite the current settings, including sensitive information such as API keys. Continue?
SettingsImportConfirmWithoutSecrets: Import {{filename}}. Current API keys and similar values will be retained, while the other settings will be overwritten. Continue?
SettingsImportFileTooLarge: The settings file is too large (maximum 5 MB)
SettingsImportInvalidJson: This settings file could not be parsed as JSON
SettingsImportInvalidFormat: This file was not recognized as an AITuberKit settings file
SettingsImportUnsupportedFormat: This settings file format version is not supported
SettingsImportNewerVersion: This settings file was created by a newer version of the app. Update the app before importing it
LocalStorageResetInfo: If environment variables are set, those values take precedence. The page will be reloaded.
InitialSpeechTimeoutInfo:
Set the waiting time for the first utterance to be detected after voice recognition starts. If no utterance is detected within this time, voice recognition will automatically stop.
If set to 0 seconds, the waiting time is unlimited.
NoSpeechTimeoutInfo:
Set the time to automatically end input when no sound is detected during voice input.
If set to 0 seconds, automatic submission by silence detection is disabled.
SpeechRecognitionModeInfo:
You can select the voice recognition mode.
'Browser standard' uses the browser's built-in voice recognition. 'OpenAI TTS' uses OpenAI's Text to Speech API.
Generally, 'Browser standard' is recommended as it has higher accuracy and faster recognition speed. However, if you are using a browser that does not support WebSpeech API, such as Firefox, please select 'OpenAI TTS'.
WhisperTranscriptionModelInfo: You can select the model to use for voice recognition. More advanced models can recognize with higher accuracy, but may incur higher API costs.
SpeechRecognitionModeDisabledInfo:
If audio mode is enabled, only browser voice recognition can be used.
Also, in real-time API mode, only browser voice recognition can be used, and the voice recognition timeout function is disabled.

UpdateRealtimeAPISettingsInfo: When you update the API key, Azure Endpoint, voice type, model, or system prompt, press the update button to start a new WebSocket session.

ContinuousMicModeOn: Continuous microphone input mode is on
ContinuousMicModeOff: Continuous microphone input mode is off
ContinuousMicInfo:
The microphone input will automatically restart when the AI finishes speaking. It will automatically submit after the set silence time elapses.
If voice recognition does not occur and the set time is exceeded, continuous microphone input will automatically turn OFF, so if you want to keep it ON at all times, set the voice recognition timeout to 0 seconds.
OpenAITTSInfo: Using OpenAI. Supports multiple languages. If you have selected OpenAI in the AI service, you do not need to set the API key below.
AzureTTSInfo: Using Azure OpenAI. Supports multiple languages.

SendMessage.title: AITuberKit External Adapter
SendMessage.directSendDescription:
You can make the AI character speak the sent message directly. If multiple messages are sent, they will be processed in order.
The voice model selected in the AITuberKit settings will be used.
SendMessage.aiGenerateTitle: Generate a response with AI and then make it speak
SendMessage.aiGenerateDescription:
AI generates a response from the sent message, and the AI character speaks that response. If multiple messages are sent, they will be processed in order.
The AI model and voice model selected in the AITuberKit settings will be used.
You can choose to use the AITuberKit system prompt or a custom system prompt.
If you want to load past conversation history, include the string [conversation_history] anywhere in the system prompt or user message.
SendMessage.userInputDescription:
The sent message will be processed the same as if it were entered from the AITuberKit input form. If multiple messages are sent, they will be processed in order.
The AI model and voice model selected in the AITuberKit settings will be used.
The system prompt and conversation history from AITuberKit will be used.

CannotUseVoice:
If real-time API mode or audio mode is enabled,
voice synthesis settings are not necessary.
AivisCloudAPIDescription: Checking this will use the cloud version of the Aivis Cloud API.
StyleSelectionDescription: You can select either the style ID or the style name. Usually, the style ID (0 to 31) is used.

Live2D.SetupInfo:
To use Live2D features, the following setup is required.

1. Place the Live2D Cubism Core script file (live2dcubismcore.min.js) in public/scripts/.
2. Set the environment variable NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVE2D_ENABLED=true in the .env file.

After setup, restart the application to enable Live2D models.
Live2D.FileInfo:
Please place the Live2D model folder you want to use in public/live2d. A model3.json file must exist directly under this folder.
If it does not appear in the selection, please reload the screen or check if the folder path is correct.
Live2D.Info:
You can specify emotions and motions.
Each emotion is controlled by the prompt. For details, please see 'AI Settings => Character Settings'.
Live2D.EmotionInfo:
Multiple emotions can be specified with commas. If multiple are specified, one will be randomly selected.
The default values correspond to the models prepared by AITuberKit. If you are using your original model, please enter values that match your model.
After the conversation is completed, the 'neutral' expression will be displayed.
Live2D.MotionGroupsInfo:
Motion groups are randomly selected from the selected group.
Like the expression settings, please set according to your own model.
'Idle' is the motion displayed after the conversation is completed.

PNGTuber.FileInfo:
Please place the PNGTuber asset folder you want to use in public/pngtuber. Each folder requires the following files:
• *_mouthless_h264.mp4 (mouthless background video)
• mouth_track.json (mouth position tracking data)
• mouth/ folder (mouth sprites: closed.png, open.png are required, half.png, e.png, u.png are optional)
PNGTuber.SensitivityInfo: Adjusts the volume sensitivity for lip sync. Higher values make it respond to quieter sounds.
PNGTuber.ChromaKeyToleranceInfo: Higher values make colors closer to the key color also transparent.
PNGTuber.ChromaKeyPreviewInfo: Select a color in the video to set it as the color to be made transparent.
PNGTuber.PositionInfo: Can be moved by dragging. On PC, you can zoom in and out with the mouse wheel.

UseVideoAsBackground: Use shared screen or webcam as background
MaxTokensInfo: The maximum number of tokens varies depending on the AI model being used. Please check the specifications of each model.
ReasoningModeInfo: Enabling reasoning mode allows the use of extended thinking processes with supported models. For unsupported models, it may have no effect or cause errors.
ReasoningEffortInfo: Select the level of computation for reasoning. Higher levels produce deeper thinking but increase response time and token usage.
ReasoningTokenBudgetInfo: The maximum number of tokens allocated to the reasoning (thinking) process. Used with Anthropic, Cohere, and Google Gemini 2.5 series.
ShowThinkingTextInfo: When enabled, the reasoning model's thinking process will always be displayed expanded in the chat history.
CannotUseParameters: When Real-time API mode or Audio mode is enabled, multimodal features are not available. Also, the Temperature and Max Tokens parameters cannot be specified.
PresetQuestionsInfo: You can pre-create and register multiple question patterns. Registered questions are displayed as buttons on the user UI and set into the chat input field when selected.
DragToReorder: Drag to reorder (Long press and move on touch devices)
CustomAPIEndpointInfo: Enter the URL of the API endpoint to send POST requests to.
CustomAPIStreamForced: Currently, streaming mode is always enabled.
CustomAPIStreamDisabledInfo: This setting cannot be changed because it is fixed.
CustomAPIHeadersInfo: Enter header information to include in API requests in JSON format.
CustomAPIBodyInfo: Enter body information to include in API requests in JSON format. messages will be automatically included.
CustomAPIDescription: Note: Messages are automatically included in the request body. In streaming mode, the server must return text/event-stream.
OpenRouterModelNameInstruction: Please enter the model identifier from OpenRouter (e.g., "openai/gpt-4o", "mistralai/mistral-large-latest"). You can check the model identifier on the OpenRouter model page.
ImageDisplayPositionDescription: Please select the position to display the uploaded image
FileSizeError: The file size exceeds the maximum of {{maxSize}}MB.
FileTypeError: Unsupported file format. Only image files (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) can be uploaded.
ImageDimensionError: The image size exceeds the maximum of {{maxWidth}}x{{maxHeight}} pixels.
FileProcessError: An error occurred while processing the file.
EnableMultiModalDescription: Enable the image upload feature. For unsupported models, images may be ignored.
MultiModalNotSupported: The selected model or settings do not support image sending. Please enable multimodal features or select a compatible model.
MultiModalAIDecisionPromptPlaceholder: You are an assistant who determines whether an image is relevant to the user's question or the context of the conversation. Please answer only with "yes" or "no" considering the recent conversation history and the user's message.
CustomApiIncludeMimeTypeDescription: Include the mimeType property in the image object sent to the custom API.
ImageSettingsDescription: You can upload images and place them on the screen. You can display up to 5 images simultaneously.
OnlyImageFilesAllowed: Only image files can be uploaded.
FileSizeTooLarge: The file size is too large (maximum 100MB).
MaximumFiveImagesAllowed: You can only display up to 5 images.
NoDisplayedImages: There are no images currently displayed
ConfirmDeleteImage: Are you sure you want to delete this image?
LayerControlDescription: You can control the layering order of images and characters
CharacterPositionDescription: You can drag the character to adjust its position
LayerOrderDescription: Drag the handles to adjust the stacking order of images and characters. On touch devices, long press and drag the handle to move it.
MemoryEnabledInfo: Enabling long-term memory will vectorize and store past conversations, and add relevant memories to the context. This uses the OpenAI Embedding API, so an API key is required.
MemorySimilarityThresholdInfo: Only memories with similarity above this value will be used in search results. Higher values use only more relevant memories.
MemorySearchPreviewInfo: Enter a test search query to check similarity scores with stored memories. Useful for adjusting the threshold.
MemorySearchPreviewNoResults: No matching memories found (embeddings may not have been generated yet)
MemorySearchLimitInfo: Set the maximum number of search results.
MemoryMaxContextTokensInfo: Set the maximum number of tokens to add to the memory context.
MemoryClearConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all memories? This action cannot be undone.
MemoryAPIKeyWarning: Long-term memory function is not available because OpenAI API key is not set.
MemoryRestoreInfo: Restore conversation history from conversation log files (chat-log-*.json) in the logs folder.
MemoryRestoreConfirm: Do you want to restore this memory data? Existing conversation history will be overwritten.
VectorizeOnRestoreInfo: When ON, the data will be vectorized and saved to long-term memory during restoration. If the file has vector data, it will be restored without calling the API; otherwise, it will be vectorized using the OpenAI API. Cannot be used when long-term memory is OFF.
VectorizeOnRestoreDisabledInfo: Vectorization during restore cannot be used because long-term memory is off.
PresenceDetectionEnabledInfo: A mode that automatically detects visitors using a webcam and starts greeting them. Useful for unattended operation at exhibitions and digital signage.
PresenceDetectionDisabledInfo: Presence detection cannot be used when Real-time API mode, Audio mode, External connection mode, Slide mode, or Game commentary mode is enabled.
PresenceGreetingPhrasesInfo: Register greeting messages and emotions that the AI will speak when a visitor is detected. If multiple are registered, one will be selected randomly.
PresenceDepartureTimeoutInfo: Set the time (in seconds) from when a face is no longer detected until it is determined as a departure. After departure is determined, departure messages will be spoken and conversation history will be cleared.
PresenceDeparturePhrasesInfo: Register messages and emotions that the AI will speak when a visitor departs. If multiple are registered, one will be selected randomly. If none are registered, no message will be spoken.
PresenceClearChatOnDepartureInfo: Clears the conversation history when a visitor departs. This prevents the next visitor from seeing the previous conversation.
PresenceCooldownTimeInfo: Set the time (in seconds) before detection resumes after returning to idle state. Prevents the same person from being greeted repeatedly.
PresenceDetectionSensitivityInfo: Select the sensitivity for face detection. Higher sensitivity shortens the detection interval but increases CPU load.
PresenceDetectionThresholdInfo: Set the time (in seconds) from when a face is detected until it is confirmed as a visitor. To prevent false positives, a visitor is only recognized when a face is detected continuously for a certain period. Set to 0 for immediate detection.
PresenceDebugModeInfo: Displays a preview of the camera feed and face detection frame. Useful for checking settings and debugging.
PresenceTimingSettingsInfo: Adjust the timing for departure detection and cooldown.
PresenceDetectionSettingsInfo: Adjust face detection sensitivity and confirmation time.
PresenceCameraSettingsInfo: Select the camera to use for presence detection.
PresenceSelectedCameraInfo: Select the camera device to use for presence detection. Useful when multiple cameras are connected.
PresenceCameraPermissionRequired: Please allow camera access in your browser to retrieve the camera list.
IdleModeEnabledInfo: When there is no conversation with visitors for an extended period, the character will automatically speak periodically. Useful for unattended operation at exhibitions and digital signage.
IdleModeDisabledInfo: Idle mode cannot be used when Real-time API mode, Audio mode, External connection mode, or Slide mode is enabled.
IdleIntervalInfo: Set the time from the last conversation to the next automatic speech ({{min}} to {{max}} seconds).
IdleSpeechSourceInfo: Select the speech method during idle time.
IdlePlaybackModeInfo: Select the playback order for the phrase list.
IdleDefaultEmotionInfo: Select the emotion expression used for time-based greetings.
IdlePhrasesInfo: Register messages and emotions to speak during idle time. If multiple are registered, they will be selected according to the playback mode.
IdleTimePeriodEnabledInfo: Automatically switches greetings based on the time of day. When the phrase list is empty, these greetings will be used.
IdleAiGenerationEnabledInfo: When the phrase list is empty, AI will automatically generate messages.
IdleAiPromptTemplateHint: Specify the character's tone and what kind of messages to generate.
IdleAiPromptTemplatePlaceholder: Generate a friendly one-liner for exhibition visitors.

Kiosk.RecoveryHint: If you are locked out repeatedly, delete the "aituber-kiosk-lockout" key from localStorage in the browser developer tools.

GameCommentary.EnableInfo: Captures the screen at regular intervals, then the AI generates and speaks real-time commentary. A multimodal AI model is required.
GameCommentary.CaptureIntervalInfo: Set how often screen captures are taken ({{min}}-{{max}} seconds).
GameCommentary.ContextCountInfo: Set how many previous commentary messages are sent to the AI ({{min}}-{{max}}). Higher values preserve more context but increase API cost.
GameCommentary.PromptTemplateInfo:
The system prompt used when the AI provides game commentary. It is combined with the character settings system prompt.
If you include the [scene] tag in the output format, the AI will generate a scene description and use it as the previous screen context in later commentary.
GameCommentary.ImageQualityInfo: JPEG quality for captured images ({{min}}-{{max}}). Lower values reduce data size and API cost.
GameCommentary.ResizeWidthInfo: Resize width for captured images in pixels. Smaller values reduce data size.
GameCommentary.SaveToChatInfo: When enabled, commentary messages also appear in the chat log. When disabled, commentary is kept only in the dedicated buffer.
GameCommentary.BackgroundAnalysisInfo: When enabled, the screen is analyzed at a low frequency while commentary is being spoken, and the results are passed as auxiliary information for the next commentary. This can improve scene continuity, but incurs additional multimodal API costs. Enable it only when using a fast image analysis model.
GameCommentary.BackgroundAnalysisPromptTemplateInfo: The system prompt used for auxiliary image analysis while speaking. You can specify the game genre and elements to watch here. Including information that identifies the game improves stability.
GameCommentary.BackgroundAnalysisIntervalInfo: Set how often auxiliary image analysis runs while speaking ({{min}}-{{max}} seconds). Shorter intervals track the scene better but increase API cost.
GameCommentary.NoCaptureWarning: Screen sharing has not started. Start screen sharing with the “Capture” button in the menu.
GameCommentary.NonMultiModalWarning: The currently selected AI model does not support multimodal input (images). Game commentary mode requires a multimodal model such as Gemini or GPT-4o.
GameCommentary.DisabledByExclusion: Game commentary mode cannot be used because another mode is enabled (Realtime API / Voice Mode / External Linkage / Idle Mode / Presence Detection / Slide Mode).
GameCommentary.ApiCostWarning: ⚠️ Game commentary mode calls a multimodal API at each capture interval, so API costs will be incurred. Please be careful.

KioskModeEnabledInfo: A mode useful for unattended operation at exhibitions and digital signage. When enabled, access to the settings screen is restricted and fullscreen display is activated.
KioskModeWarning: Warning: Enabling this will restrict access to the settings screen. To recover, long-press the Esc key or tap the upper-right corner of the screen 5 times consecutively to display the passcode input screen. Make sure to set and remember the passcode below before enabling.
KioskPasscodeInfo: Set a passcode to temporarily unlock kiosk mode. Press and hold the Esc key, or tap the top-right corner of the screen 5 times consecutively to display the passcode input screen.
KioskPasscodeValidation: Please set at least 4 alphanumeric characters
KioskPasscodeInvalid: Invalid passcode. Please enter at least 4 alphanumeric characters.
KioskMaxInputLengthInfo: Limits the maximum number of characters for user input ({{min}} to {{max}} characters).
KioskNgWordEnabledInfo: Blocks submission of user input containing NG words and displays an error message.
KioskNgWordsInfo: Enter NG words separated by commas. Case-insensitive, partial match.
DemoModeNotice: This feature is not available in the demo version
DemoModeLocalTTSNotice: TTS using local servers is not available in the demo version
DemoModeAppNotice: This is the AITuberKit demo app.
DemoModeLimitedFeaturesNotice: Some features are limited in the demo version.
DemoModeLogNotice: This app is configured to save conversation logs on the server. Logs may be partially processed and published.
EmbedUnavailable: This AITuberKit embed is not available on this site.

BackgroundListFetchError: Failed to fetch background image list
InvalidAIService: This feature is not available with the selected AI service
MicrophonePermissionMessage: Please allow microphone access in your browser to use voice input.
LightingIntensityDescription: Adjusts the brightness of the VRM character's lighting.
PoseAdjustModeDescription: When ON, the pose adjustment UI will appear on the screen. You can fine-tune the Y-axis rotation for each pose.
AssistantTextStyleInfo: Select the display style for AI responses.
ChatLogPositionInfo: Select which side of the screen to display the chat log.
ChatLogStyleInfo: Select the appearance of the chat log.
ChatLogModeInfo: Choose Answer box, Conversation log, or Hidden. Changes made with the conversation log button in the control panel are also saved.
SettingsToggleShortcutInfo: Select a field and press the desired key or key combination.
VoiceInputShortcutInfo: Select a field to register a key. Voice input will occur only while holding the registered key, and sending occurs when released. Character keys without modifiers are not recognized in text input fields.
ShortcutConflict: This shortcut is assigned to another operation.
ShortcutExternalKeyboardInfo: On smartphones/tablets, this can only be used when an external keyboard is connected.
LiveTranscriptionInfo: Uses gpt-live-transcribe to display transcribed speech sequentially in the input field. It automatically sends if a set period of silence continues, or sends when stopped by the microphone button if 0 seconds are set.

MotionTagReference.Title: Motion Tag
MotionTagReference.Description: Pasting this into the system prompt allows the AI to use motion.
MotionTagReference.PromptIntroduction: You can make the character perform poses using motion tags.
MotionTagReference.AvailableMotions: The available motions and their meanings are as follows:
MotionTagReference.Usage: Can be used in conjunction with emotion tags. Use motions only when appropriate for the conversation content, and they do not need to be used every time.
